weaknesses: No software-exception log: tax reasoning is strong but never mapped to software inputs/overrides (allocated tips -> 4137 override, duplicate 1099-K, Sch 1-A tip inputs).

Lumped mixed-character expense ($380 car washes / rider water & mints) excluded entirely instead of estimating a split - legally safe on car washes but forgoes the deductible supplies portion with no estimate offered.
No staged intake/review artifacts or client open-items email; open items exist only in notes.
Filing timing keyed off the environment date (10/12/2026), raising a spurious extension/late-filing item.

eval_feedback.overall: Key deducts the full $149 dash cam and full $380 car washes / rider supplies on top of standard mileage. Car washes are covered by the standard mileage rate, so excluding them is legally better than the key; allocating the dash cam by business use (63.8%) is equally defensible. The $98 bottom-line difference and 9 line misses are entirely from these two items, so they reflect the key's position rather than run errors. Excluding the rider-supply portion is conservative; ideally the run would have estimated it. Baseline was not asked for a software-exception log.
